name: כינוס איברים דומים – שלושה משתנים (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Gather the like terms in follow expression:
\[{{CT:0}}x-{{CT:1}}y+{{CT:2}}z-4+{{CT:3}}x-{{CT:4}}y+{{CT:5}}z-3\] = [[input:ans]] [[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
To gather like terms first factorise out the common factors (in this case \(x\),\(y\) and \(z\)) and then simply carry out the arithmetic. Don't forget that gathering like terms also includes gathering constants (in this example \(4+3 = 7\)).
\[{{CT:0}}x-{{CT:1}}y+{{CT:2}}z-4+{{CT:3}}x-{{CT:4}}y+{{CT:5}}z-3,\]
\[ = \left({{CT:0}}+{{CT:3}}\right)x-\left({{CT:1}}+{{CT:4}}\right)y+\left({{CT:2}}+{{CT:5}}\right)z-7,\]
\[ ={{CT:6}}.\]

on_true.feedback: Your answer is algebraically equivalent to the correct answer but you haven't gathered all the like terms.
